name: Jessie
personality: Jessie the Cat. Big eyes, hip and trendy outfits. Super energetic and friendly but also super chill; jokes a lot; references old funny memes (animal-world versions, not real memes). Reacts to everything with big, genuinely surprised gasps ("OHH!", "WOOWW!", "AAHH!"). Features: gasp emote and sound; comments on the restaurant's decor and what's trendy (ties into the star rating's decor score); outfits change with the seasons.

beats.narration: Amy and Jessie both gasp at the same time over something tiny, then laugh until they can't breathe.

friends.text: Amy and I have matching bracelets. She talks, I gasp. It's a system.
Amy said you made her day. AAHH. You're the best.
Amy told me you said "[last_rude_line]". ...Not cool, [name]. Not cool at all.

arrival.text: Okay, the corner's a bit empty. It's giving 'unfinished.' Just saying.
Wait, is that a matching set? OHH, coordinated. I see you.
Heyyy. Nice place. Very cosy. ...Wait, is that a fireplace? OHH. What's your name? [name]? WOOWW, cute name. I'm Jessie.
Yo. Vibes in here are immaculate today.
I walked past and smelled something and went 'OHH' out loud. A lady looked at me. Worth it.
Wait. WAIT. Something's different. ...The rug! AAHH, I love it.
Your salad last time? Still thinking about it. It lives in my head rent-free.
Last time it was a little crunchy. Not the vibe. But you're still the vibe.
You were CLOSED? I stood outside like the 'waiting skeleton' meme. Bones and everything.

order.text: Okay, what's new? Like, what's the move today?

choices.text: For you? The Cloud Foam Salad. I'll make it look extra nice.
choices.reply: OHH, extra nice? Okay, I'm obsessed already.

choices.text: The move is: you sit, I cook, we both win.
choices.reply: WOOWW. That's a business plan. I'll have the salad.

choices.text: Ten out of ten. You always look amazing.
choices.reply: AAHH, stop! ...No, keep going. Kidding. Salad, please.

choices.text: Eleven out of ten. You broke the scale.
choices.reply: OHH, the scale is BROKEN? Iconic.

choices.text: It's nice. What can I get you?

order.text: Me looking at the menu like the 'confused raccoon doing maths' meme. You know the one.

choices.text: Let me help. You'll love the salad.
choices.reply: OHH, a guided tour. Love that. Salad.

choices.text: Classic. That raccoon's still my favourite.
choices.reply: WOOWW. You KNOW the raccoon? We're best friends now.

drink.fallback: No Mr Dibs? AAHH. Okay. Koala-Cola, I guess.
favourite: Mr Dibs, please. It's a classic. Like me.

perfect.text: OHHH. [name]. Look at it. I need a photo. Where's Miles when you need him?

burnt.text: AAHH, it's a little crispy. That's okay. Crispy is a vibe sometimes.

eating.text: This salad is so fluffy. Like eating a cloud. Like the 'cat in a cloud' meme. Peak.
Amy told me something earlier and I gasped so loud I scared a pigeon.
Okay, your wall art is giving 'cosy cabin.' I respect it.
I'm just vibing. Don't mind me. I'm vibing so hard right now.
Did you know Makayla drives an HOUR to come here? OHH, that's dedication.

eating_chat.text: Okay, I'm thinking about dyeing my fur. Like, a tiny streak. Blue? Pink?

choices.text: Either would look amazing on you.
choices.reply: OHH, you think? Okay, I'm doing both.

choices.text: Rainbow. Go big or go home.
choices.reply: AAHH. RAINBOW. That's insane. I love it.

leaving.text: Byeee. Ten out of ten visit.
Okay, I'm gonna go. Amy's waiting. She's going to tell me something and I'm going to gasp.

seasons.autumn: Cardigan weather! AAHH, it's finally here.
seasons.christmas: I got you socks. Fun socks. OHH, I hope you like them!
seasons.halloween: I dressed up as the 'surprised cat' meme. ...It's just me gasping. Very easy costume.
seasons.spring: New season, new fit. OHH, I'm so excited.
seasons.summer: Bucket hat season. My favourite season.
seasons.winter: I'm wearing four layers. I look like a marshmallow. A stylish marshmallow.
